title: Google Pixel Watch 3 Wi-Fi 45mm $249 + $6.99/$8.99 Delivery Only @ JB Hi-Fi
body:
Deal: Google Pixel Watch 3 Wi-Fi 45mm $249 + $6.99/$8.99 Delivery Only @ JB Hi-Fi

[skibidigrimacmoggr67] but the 4 is out and the 5 is about to be released??
read comments about very limited software update as well only 3 years from release I think.
[khaez] Yeah, definitely not for those looking for the latest and greatest. I needed a new watch, so grabbed one. But didn't feel like spending more than double this for the 4 (45mm). And seeing how prices have increased on tech lately, won't be surprised if the 5 is triple this price.
[skibidigrimacmoggr67] ok no issue with the deal for me. as you can see didn't bad deal vote.
just thought I've seen the older models posted for around $199 at one point a couple times. tbf I think the might have been Pixel watch 1 or 2. but tech just gets old quickly.
[cook99] Probably thinking of the 41mm.
I paid $199 for the 41mm Pixel 3, then traded it in via Telstra to upgrade to the 41mm 4.
As someone who has used both in short succession, I feel the 4 is absolutely worth the extra money.
[jaboday423] @cook99: How much did you pay for Pixel Watch 4 for Telstra during upgrade (Trade in Pixel Watch 3)?
[King Steuart] I'll probably get a pixel watch when my Sense dies
[Desleydee] This looks decent. I have a pixel watch 2 and it's a bit scratched up. Is there a meaningful difference between the 3, 4 and likely 5 beyond a bit longer battery and brighter screen?
[PurpleMonkeyDwasher] Upgrades too apparently. I'm trying to justify whether I get a newer one myself.
[khaez] It's mainly, software updates, smaller bezels, bigger battery, more efficient chip, small upgrades here and there. Upgrading 1 gen up might not make much of a difference, but for this price, it's not bad if your watch 2 is banged up. Or you can wait until the 4 goes on sale when the 5 releases. But tbh, seeing how prices are increasing lately, might be waiting a while.
[dontpanic] I'm waiting for the 5 to come out and hoping to snag a 4 (41mm) at this price or lower. Can't justify spending much more than that on a product that has such short planned obsolescence.
[Wip3out] It's a shame they have determined EOL.
My PW2 is still going fine, battery is fine with screen always on as I'm happy to charge once a day (main use tracking sleep, steps, HR, notifications), I cant see why I would even upgrade as I don't want/need any more features - the same reason I am still using a Pixel 6A.
